desc: Compute inc[]: length of longest strictly increasing subarray ending at i.
Compute right[]: length of longest strictly increasing subarray starting at i.
Compute prefix sums pref[0..N] for O(1) range sum queries.
For each K, L = K - inc[K] + 1, R = K + right[K] - 1, B_K = pref[R] - pref[L-1].
